name: Shipping
description: Shipping costs by country: one row per zone, the countries it covers (ISO codes, comma-separated), the cost, and an optional free-shipping threshold. Checkout offers only countries that are in Settings › Ships to AND have a row here, and adds the cost to the order before payment. Empty Currency = the shop's currency. A change shows on the website within about a minute.

agentPrompts.body: Read the `busa-shop` skill in this folder and follow "Payments and orders (收款与订单)", "Shipping costs (运费)": change the shipping rows to the costs, countries, free-shipping threshold and delivery times I give you. Show me the rows before and after, write them after I say yes, and tell me which Ships to countries still have no rate (they cannot check out). Never invent a cost or a delivery time.

label.en: Which countries can order, and what does shipping cost?
label.zh-CN: 哪些国家能下单？运费多少？

agentPrompts.body: Read the `busa-shop` skill in this folder, then list the countries in Settings › Ships to with the shipping cost, free-shipping threshold and delivery time each one gets at checkout, and every country that cannot check out because it has no usable row (or a row in another currency, or a country named twice).
